blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Provisioning services encompass direct tangible goods derived from ecosystems, such as food, fresh water, timber, fiber, and medicines.
Regulating services maintain environmental balance by governing climate, managing flood control, and providing disease regulation.
Supporting services underpin the production of all other services through basic ecological processes like nutrient cycling, soil formation, and primary production.
Cultural services represent non-material ecosystem benefits including recreation, tourism, and spiritual value.

blocks.content: • Regulating Services – climate regulation, flood control, disease regulation.

items: Exams frequently test the classification of ecosystem services: Soil formation and nutrient cycling are Supporting Services, not Regulating Services.
Climate regulation and flood control strictly fall under Regulating Services.
Direct natural products like medicines, timber, and fresh water are classified as Provisioning Services.
